Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 6, 2026

Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use www.viewturbo.com (the "Website") and the ViewTurbo VPN applications (the "Apps"), operated by VIEWTURBO PTE. LTD. The sections below describe our Website practices and the additional practices specific to the Apps.

ViewTurbo VPN Applications
Account, device, and purchase information

The Apps and our service process your email address, account identifier, authentication credentials, device and app version information, connection IP address, and membership status to create and secure your account and provide the VPN service. We record service usage totals, including traffic volume, to operate the service and manage usage limits. Settings such as per-app routing and domain rules are used to configure your connection.

When you make an in-app purchase, Apple or Google processes the payment. We process purchase receipts or tokens, product identifiers, order information, and account-linked purchase history to verify payment and grant the purchased membership. Google Play purchases use a hashed account identifier to associate the purchase with your ViewTurbo account. We do not receive your full payment card number from these stores.

VPN traffic

When you choose to connect, ViewTurbo uses the device VPN service to route the traffic selected by your routing settings through a remote VPN endpoint. Traffic sent through the VPN tunnel is encrypted between your device and that endpoint. The endpoint processes network destinations and packets as needed to forward your connection. We do not save logs of websites visited or destination addresses. Aggregate traffic totals and account or connection information are separate from website browsing logs.

Per-app routing uses the locally installed app list on Android so you can select which apps use the VPN; this list is used on your device for routing configuration. The Apps do not use advertising IDs or include third-party advertising.

Service providers and international processing

Our hosting and network providers process information needed to operate the service. Apple and Google process payments and store-related information under their own privacy policies. Your selected VPN endpoint and service infrastructure may be located outside your country. Information is used for service delivery, account management, security, purchase verification, and support, rather than advertising. We do not sell personal information.

Account deletion and retention

You can request deletion from the account controls in the App or at Delete your ViewTurbo account. You can also contact [email] if you cannot access your account. Deletion is permanent once completed. If a recovery period applies, the service shows the scheduled deletion date; signing in during that period can cancel the request. The current account deletion workflow uses a seven-day recovery period.

Account data and associated service records are removed through the deletion workflow. Payment stores retain their own transaction records under their own policies. Backups and infrastructure records may persist until their normal rotation or removal; information required for legal obligations, security, or resolving a dispute may be retained for those purposes. Contact [email] for questions about your data or deletion request.

Age eligibility

ViewTurbo is intended for people aged 13 and above and is not directed to children under 13. If you believe a child under 13 has provided personal information, contact [email] so we can investigate and remove it.

Information We Collect

We may collect the following types of information:

Personal Information: Information that can be used to identify you personally, such as your name, email address, and billing information, when you register or use our services.
Non-Personal Information: Information that does not directly identify you, such as your browser type, device type, and usage data, which we collect through cookies and similar technologies.
How We Use Your Information

Provide Services: We use your personal information to provide, maintain, and improve the services you request, including network acceleration and user interaction features.

Communicate with You: We may use your contact information to send you updates, newsletters, or respond to your inquiries.

Analyze Usage: Non-personal information helps us understand how users interact with the Website, enabling us to improve the user experience.

How We Protect Your Information

We implement a variety of security measures to maintain the safety of your personal information. However, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure. Therefore, we cannot guarantee its absolute security.

Sharing Your Information

We do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer your personal information to third parties except in the following circumstances:

If required by law or in response to valid legal processes.
To trusted service providers who assist us in operating the Website and conducting our business, so long as those parties agree to keep this information confidential.
Cookies

The Website may use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance user experience and gather non-personal data about site usage. You can choose to disable cookies through your browser settings, but doing so may affect the functionality of the Website.

Your Choices and Rights

You may choose to:

Access and Update Your Information: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information by contacting us at [email].
Opt-Out: You may opt out of receiving newsletters or promotional emails by following the instructions in those emails or by contacting us directly.
Children's Privacy

The Website is not directed to children under the age of 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe that a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us so we can take appropriate action.

Changes to the Privacy Policy

We reserve the right to update this Privacy Policy at any time. Any changes will be effective immediately upon posting on the Website. Continued use of the Website after such changes constitutes your acceptance of the revised policy.

Contact Information

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at [email].
